nodes.label: Centered Blue Gradient Logo Mark
nodes.description: Small light-to-mid blue gradient glyph of two parallel diagonal bars with perpendicular arms, occupying roughly 6 percent of the canvas width at dead center. Visually matches the stock Capacitor framework logo rather than a custom app brand.

nodes.label: iOS Splash Screen Image (2732x2732)
nodes.description: Square 2732x2732 launch splash asset for the iOS app. Plain white background with a single small blue gradient logo mark centered: two offset diagonal bars with short perpendicular arms forming an X-like glyph. No text, no ZAKA branding.

nodes.label: Default Capacitor Splash Placeholder
nodes.description: The splash appears to be the unmodified template asset generated when the Capacitor iOS platform is added, meaning the app-specific ZAKA launch branding has not been applied to the iOS splash.

nodes.label: Universal Square Splash Layout
nodes.rationale: A single oversized square canvas (2732px matches the long edge of the largest iPad) with a tiny centered mark and wide empty margins lets one image be center-cropped to any device size and orientation without clipping the logo.
